text.div:
Title: FLC Liquid Templates
Id: FLCLiquidTemplates
Version: 0.2.2
Url: FLC Liquid Templates
Type:

system: http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/library-type

code: logic-library

Date: 2025-07-14 07:00:22+0100
Publisher: Region Skåne - Enheten för digitalisering
Description:

This library includes the LIQUID-templates and source sampledata used in this FLC-IG
Topic:
Approval Date: 2025-07-14
Content: text/liquid
File Name: PatientPmoExtractTransactionBundle.liquid
Folder: templates
Relative Path: templates/PatientPmoExtractTransactionBundle.liquid
{% comment %}
==========================================================================
Template:     PatientPmoExtractTransactionBundle
Purpose:      Generates a FHIR TransactionBundle for a single PMO patient.
Version:      0.0.1
Author:       Region Skåne/@olof.mattsson
Date:         2025-07-08

Context:
  -PMO PatientJSON från vyn facade.Patient

Parameters:

Output:
  - FHIR Bundle resource with:
      - Patient
==========================================================================
{% endcomment %}
{% include 'variables/shared' -%}
{% include 'variables/aliases' -%}
{% assign bundle_id = Patient.PatientID | generate_id_input: "Bundle", false | generate_uuid -%}
{% assign full_bundle_id = bundle_id | prepend: "urn:uuid:" -%}
{
  "resourceType": "Bundle",
  "type": "document",
  "id": "{{ bundle_id }}",
  "timestamp": "{{ Meta.ExtractDate }}+01:00",
  "entry": [
    {% include 'resources/patient' %}
  ]
}
Content: text/liquid
File Name: _shared.liquid
Folder: templates/variables
Relative Path: templates/variables/_shared.liquid
{% comment -%} Debug variables {% endcomment -%}
{% assign variable_debug_todo = "ToDo" -%}
{% assign variable_system_todo = "http://todo.fix/backlogg/identifiersystem/todo" -%}

{% assign Patient = msg.Data.Patient -%}
{% assign Meta = msg.Meta -%}
{% assign patient_id =  Patient.PatientID | generate_id_input: Patient.CodeNumber, false | generate_uuid -%}
{% assign full_patient_id = patient_id | prepend: "urn:uuid:" -%}
Content: text/liquid
File Name: _aliases.liquid
Folder: templates/variables
Relative Path: templates/variables/_aliases.liquid
{% comment -%} Fhir shorthand aliases {% endcomment -%}
Content: text/liquid
File Name: _patient.liquid
Folder: templates/resources
Relative Path: templates/resources/_patient.liquid
{
  "fullUrl": "{{ full_patient_id }}",
  "resource": {
    "resourceType": "Patient",
    "id": "{{ patient_id }}",
    "meta": {
      "profile": [
        "http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/ips/StructureDefinition/Patient-uv-ips",
        "http://hl7.se/fhir/ig/base/StructureDefinition/SEBasePatient"
      ],
      "security": [
        {
          "system": "http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-Confidentiality",
          "code": "{{ Patient.ConfidentialData == true | ternary: 'R', 'N' }}",
          "display": "{{ Patient.ConfidentialData == true | ternary: 'restricted', 'normal' }}"
        }
      ]
    },
    "name": [
      {
        "text": "{{ Patient.Name }}"
      }
    ],
    "identifier": [
      {
        "value": "{{ Patient.CodeNumber }}",
        "type": {
          "coding": [
            {
              "code": "{{ Patient.CodeNumberType }}",
              {% case Patient.CodeNumberType %}
                {% when 'A' %}
                  "display": "Samordningsnummer",
                {% when 'B' %}
                  "display": "Reservnummer",
                {% when 'C' %}
                  "display": "Personnummer",
                {% else %}
                  "display": "Okänd",
              {% endcase %}
              "system": "{{ variable_system_todo }}"
            }
          ]
        },
        {% case Patient.CodeNumberType -%}
          {% when 'A' -%}
            "system": "http://electronichealth.se/identifier/samordningsnummer",
          {% when 'B' -%}
            "system": "http://electronichealth.se/identifier/reservnummer",
          {% when 'C' -%}
            "system": "http://electronichealth.se/identifier/personnummer",
          {% else -%}
            "system": "http://electronichealth.se/identifier/unknown",
        {% endcase -%}
      }
    ],
{% for _patientAddress in Patient.PatientAddress -%}
  {% if forloop.first -%}
    "address": [
  {% endif -%}
  {
    "use": "home",
    "type": "{{ _patientAddress.AddressType | default: 'both' }}",
    "line": [¨
      {% if _patientAddress.CareOf -%} "c/o {{ _patientAddress.CareOf }}"{% endif -%}{% if _patientAddress.CareOf and _patientAddress.Address1 %}, {% endif %}
      {% if _patientAddress.Address1 %}"{{ _patientAddress.Address1 }}"{% endif %}{% if _patientAddress.Address1 and _patientAddress.Address2 %}, {% endif %}
      {% if _patientAddress.Address2 %}"{{ _patientAddress.Address2 }}"{% endif %}
    ],   
    {% if _patientAddress.City %}"city": "{{ _patientAddress.City }}",{% endif %}
    {% if _patientAddress.District %}"district": "{{ _patientAddress.District }}",{% endif %}
    {% if _patientAddress.State %}"state": "{{ _patientAddress.State }}",{% endif %}
    {% if _patientAddress.ZipCode %}"postalCode": "{{ _patientAddress.ZipCode }}",{% endif %}
    {% if _patientAddress.Country %}"country": "{{ _patientAddress.Country }}",{% endif %}
    "extension": [
      {
        "url": "http://hl7.se/fhir/StructureDefinition/patientAddress-id",
        "valueInteger": {{ _patientAddress.PatientAddressID }}
      },
      {
        "url": "http://hl7.se/fhir/StructureDefinition/patientAddress-active",
        "valueBoolean": {{ _patientAddress.Active == true or _patientAddress.Active == "true" | ternary: 'true', 'false' }}
      },
      {
        "url": "http://hl7.se/fhir/StructureDefinition/patientAddress-domiciled",
        "valueBoolean": {{ _patientAddress.Domiciled == true or _patientAddress.Domiciled == "true" | ternary: 'true', 'false' }}
      }
      {% if _patientAddress.CityCode %},
      {
        "url": "http://hl7.se/fhir/StructureDefinition/patientAddress-cityCode",
        "valueString": "{{ _patientAddress.CityCode }}"
      }
      {% endif %}
      {% if _patientAddress.DistrictCode %},
      {
        "url": "http://hl7.se/fhir/StructureDefinition/patientAddress-districtCode",
        "valueString": "{{ _patientAddress.DistrictCode }}"
      }
      {% endif %}
      {% if _patientAddress.StateCode %},
      {
        "url": "http://hl7.se/fhir/StructureDefinition/patientAddress-stateCode",
        "valueString": "{{ _patientAddress.StateCode }}"
      }
      {% endif %}
    ]
  }
  {% if forloop.last == false -%},{% endif -%}
  {% if forloop.last == true -%}
    ],
  {% endif %}
{% endfor %}


    "birthDate": "{{   Patient.BirthDate | date:"yyyy-MM-dd" }}",
    {% if Patient.Deceased == "true" %}
      "deceasedDateTime": "{{ Patient.DeceasedDate | default: '1970-01-01T00:00:00' }}",
    {% else %}
      "deceasedBoolean": false,
    {% endif %}

    "managingOrganization": {
      "reference": "Organization/{{ variable_debug_todo }}",
      "display": "{{ Patient.FDUnit.Name }}"
    },

    "gender": "{% case Patient.Sex %}{% when 'M' %}male{% when 'F' %}female{% when 'O' %}other{% else %}unknown{% endcase %}",
    "communication": [
      {
        "language": {
          "coding": [
            {
              "code": "{{ Patient.LanguageConcept.code }}",
              "display": "{{ Patient.LanguageConcept.display }}",
              "system": "{{ Patient.LanguageConcept.system }}"
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    ],
    "extension": [
      {% if Patient.BirthPlace  -%}
      {
        "url": "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-birthPlace",
        "valueAddress": 
        {
           "text" : "{{Patient.BirthPlace}}"
        }
      },
      {% endif %}
      {
        "url": "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-interpreterRequired",
        "valueBoolean": {{ Patient.InterpreterNeeded == "true" }}
      },
      {
        "url": "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-nationality",
        "extension": [
          {
            "url": "code",
            "valueCodeableConcept": {
              "coding": [
                {
                  "system": "urn:iso:std:iso:3166",
                  "code": "{{ Patient.NationalityConcept.code }}",
                  "display": "{{ Patient.NationalityConcept.display }}"
                }
              ]
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
  },
  "request": {
    "method": "PUT",
    "url": "Patient/{{ patient_id }}"
  }
}
